verdict.rationale: Jitsu's own blog states there is a public Management API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api, and the docs confirm an HTTP management API covering workspaces, destinations, connections, syncs and functions. However, a probe found no spec file at the standard openapi.json/swagger.json paths, and no evidence shows a downloadable raw spec file rather than a rendered reference page. The probe did not test the claimed docs.jitsu.com/api location, so it does not directly contradict the claim. Missing for 10: a confirmed downloadable machine-readable spec file URL, hands-on verification of the spec at the claimed location, and in-depth first-party docs on obtaining the spec.
